messages:
charlie: Quick Q — who's authorized to flip the "safety_mode_v2" feature to OFF in prod if latency or hallucinations spike? Need to update runbook. cc @oncall

alice: Oncall + Eng leads can flip for immediate mitigation. For anything that affects >5% traffic we want a second ACK from an eng lead or product. Not sure if that is documented anywhere current.

ben: Confirming we have the emergency toggle endpoint still: POST /internal/flags/safety_mode_v2/toggle -> only IAM group 'prod-toggle-owners' allowed. I can paste the exact curl if useful.

deploy-bot: audit event created 1843256795: toggle-request by ben for safety_mode_v2 (pending approval).

alice: Please avoid ad-hoc flips when possible. Preferred flow: 1) oncall flips to mitigate 2) create an incident ticket 3) get an ACK from oncall lead + eng lead for leaving it off >15m 4) ops records rationale in ticket and closes when safe. I'll add to runbook. :white_check_mark:

dana: Note: IAM enforced. Only members of 'prod-toggle-owners' can call the endpoint. If you need access, ping me + include justification & duration. I review weekly.

charlie: Can you paste the command for the runbook? Want to include exact steps.

ben: Sure — example we use locally:

```bash
# flip off safety_mode_v2 (requires prod-toggle-owners creds)
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.internal/internal/flags/safety_mode_v2/toggle" \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOGGLE_TOKEN' \n  -d '{"state":"off","reason":"high-latency spike"}'
```

ben: Audit query to confirm: `audit-bot query --kind=flag-toggle --name=safety_mode_v2 --since=1h`

audit-bot: audit-bot response: no toggles in last 24h. full audit: https://redwood.internal/audit/flags/safety_mode_v2

siva: Escalation checklist: if toggle required and user-visible errors persist >10m, page core-ops + sec + product. Use incident priority P1 if customer impact >5% or major latency. I'll add the paging list to runbook.

alice: I'll update the runbook with: who can flip (list), exact curl snippet, incident creation checklist, required ACKs, and audit verification step. Assigning IAM review to @dana.

charlie: Thanks all — that covers what I needed. I'll wait for the runbook PR.
